meta.description: Control plane for Apply all / Watch jobs. Dispatches GitHub Actions on the self-hosted Windows runner; does not reimplement apply logic.

parameters.content:
## Job Apply Easier (control plane)

Orchestrates existing GitHub Actions — **does not** send mail or drive browsers itself.

**Apply all** → `.github/workflows/apply-all.yml`  
**Watch** (optional) → `watch-jobs.yml`

Same inputs as Pages *Apply all*: `mail`, `easy_apply`, `easy_submit`, `easy_limit`, `user`.

**Dual-user safety:** `user` is `both` | `ravi` | `jaya` only. Runner scripts never mix mailboxes/profiles.

**Secrets:** set `GITHUB_TOKEN`, optional `NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` in n8n env — never in this JSON.

## Triggers

1. **Webhook** `POST /webhook/job-apply-easier` — one-click from phone/bookmark
2. **Manual** — test in editor
3. **Schedule** — morning cron (**disabled** by default; enable after you trust Easy Apply profiles)

Webhook body (all optional; defaults match Pages):
```
{
  "action": "apply-all",
  "user": "both",
  "mail": true,
  "easy_apply": true,
  "easy_submit": true,
  "easy_limit": 50,
  "also_watch": false
}
```
`action`: `apply-all` | `watch`

## Env / credentials

| Var | Required |
|---|---|
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Yes — PAT `repo` + `actions` |
| `GITHUB_OWNER` | No — default `raviacn95` |
| `GITHUB_REPO` | No — default `ConsultingCompanyAutomation` |
| `GITHUB_REF` | No — default `main` |
| `NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` | No — Discord/Slack incoming webhook |
| `POLL_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | No — default `36` (~12 min) |
| `POLL_SECONDS` | No — default `20` |

Allow env access in n8n (`N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`).
